title: Change boundaries of licensed premises
summary: Licensed premises owners or licensees can apply to change the boundaries of their licensed premises.
intro:
If you're the licensee and/or owner of a licensed premises, and you want to change the area of the premises, you need to apply.

Amendments to authorisations you may currently have, such as extended trading authorisation (ETA) and/or minors' areas, need to be applied for at the same time.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Licensee and/or owner of a licensed premises
what_you_need: A copy of your local council’s development consent or approval for the proposed licensed area (if required)
A colour coded plan (PDF) in A4 or A3, showing:
The appropriate application forms and payments required to amend current authorisations
A Statement of Risks and Potential Effects (SoRPE) may be required if the application is to increase licence boundaries by more than 50%

how_to_steps.text: Select the ‘Go to Liquor Licence Manager’ button.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select 'View details' for the relevant licence.
Attach any supporting documents to the application.

faqs.q: What must I do if I change the area of my licensed premises?
faqs.a: If you are the licensee and/or owner, you must apply to change the area of the premises.

faqs.q: Do I need to apply for other changes at the same time?
faqs.a: If you are changing the boundaries, you must also apply for any amendments to authorisations you currently have, such as extended trading authorisation (ETA) and/or minors' areas.

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date information on liquor licence guidelines?
faqs.a: Visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page for resources and tools.
